# Pangrapport från Ericsson – kraftigt vinstlyft för AQ

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode covers the first big day of Q3 reports on a weak, AI-worried market. Ericsson beat expectations by a wide margin and rose about 10%. AQ Group reported strong data-center- and defence-driven growth, and its CEO expects growth to continue into 2027. Nordea fell over 5% after pausing buybacks, and Kinnevik fell about 8% despite a stable NAV. The hosts describe two tracks in AI: real-world capex is still strong (TSMC, VAT Group), while markets watch for a 'canary in the coal mine' (CoreWeave). They also note that fund managers hold little cash, which contrarians read as a warning sign.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AQ — AQ Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong Q3: EBIT 259m, 18% organic growth (all volume); data center and defence demand; CEO sees good visibility and growth in 2027.

#### Reasoning

CEO James Ahlgren (company view, not independent) expects data-center electrification demand to continue. A rising share of transformers should lift margins, and the cheap US turnaround acquisition adds capacity. The net cash position funds growth. Working capital build is described as normal. The stock rose 3-5% on the report, and the hosts call AQ a winner of the AI wave.

#### Sell Triggers

- if key data center customers lose share or slow builds
- if US acquisition turnaround drags beyond ~1.5 years
- if cash flow keeps deteriorating
- if AI capex sentiment reverses

> *"min uppfattning är att vi kommer att växa även 2027"*

---

### 🟡 NDA-SE — Nordea | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Arctic Securities keeps a hold rating and calls the stock fully priced; buybacks paused for the rest of 2026, with timing in 2027 unclear.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion (Roy Tilly, Arctic Securities). The report was in line, net profit 0.1% below consensus, so estimate changes should be small. Losing buybacks worth ~2% of market cap (Citi) hurts the yield case. Bank stocks had run up strongly this year. Lending margin is under competitive pressure, partly offset by deposit margin.

#### Sell Triggers

- if buybacks are not resumed in 2027
- if net interest margin declines due to lending competition
- if risk exposure increase is larger than expected

> *"Vi har en behållande rekommendation på aktien från förr. Vi tycker att den har blivit relativt fullprissatt."*

---

### 🟠 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Big beat (adj. EBIT 9.8bn vs 7.5bn), 7% organic growth; new CEO reshuffles management; stock up ~10%, but it tends to swing a lot on report days.

#### Reasoning

The host (Martin Blomgren) calls the report clearly better on profit and growth, a good start for the new CEO, and says cost pressure is well handled. Caveats: the underlying market lacks growth, memory and semiconductor cost pressure persists, and the stock is volatile around reports (it fell 12-13% after the last one). More management changes may follow.

#### Sell Triggers

- if component cost increases cannot be passed on to customers
- if underlying RAN market stays without growth
- if management reshuffle disrupts execution

> *"klart bättre resultat och tillväxt"*

---

### 🟠 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Stable NAV and narrowing discount under the new CEO; SEK ~5bn to invest, pivoting to Europe and cash-generative firms; stock down ~8% after a +20% Q3.

#### Reasoning

The host sees stabilisation as positive and expects the discount to shrink if the new strategy is executed well. He questions whether SEK 5bn is enough to take influential stakes in mature, more expensive companies. Portfolio holdings are still loss-making (EBITDA margin -4%), and 59% of the portfolio is in the US with dollar exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if portfolio values resume declining
- if capital is deployed poorly
- if NAV discount widens again

> *"Rabatten kommer att minska då om de gör det rätt."*

---

### 🟢 TELIA — Telia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Deutsche Bank upgraded it to buy after a sector review of a recently pressured telecom sector; stock up nearly 4%.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion (Deutsche Bank). The upgrade rests on a sector-wide review after recent pressure on telecom stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if telecom sector pressure persists
- if Deutsche Bank reverses its rating

> *"Där har Deutsche Bank höjt rekommendationen till köp."*

---

### 🟡 MYCR — Mycronic | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

SEB downgraded it to hold; stock down 6-7% amid semiconductor and AI worries.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion: SEB cut its rating to hold. The weak tape in semiconductor-exposed industrials added to the move.

#### Sell Triggers

- if semiconductor capex slows
- if further downgrades follow

> *"Där har vi ju en nedgraderad rekommendation från SEB som sänker till behåll."*

---

### 🟠 VACN — VAT Group | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Q3 orders +193% to CHF 697m, positive 2027 comments; read-across to Atlas Copco vacuum.

#### Reasoning

The hosts point to strong semiconductor vacuum demand. They contrast it with Atlas Copco falling on AI worries and note that real capex keeps building fast while markets fear the cycle ending.

#### Sell Triggers

- if semiconductor capex cycle turns
- if AI capex worries materialise in orders

> *"193 procent var orderingången upp"*
